title: Ket Buchholz
content:
Ket Buchholz

Executive Function Coach

Coaching style

Approachable, Responsive, Holistic

Who I work best with

I work best with adult professionals, either starting or transitioning their career, to help them find direction, stability, and manage day to day demands alongside long-term pursuits.

Top areas I support

  • Routines and habits
  • Planning and prioritizing
  • Career direction / career transition
  • PDA support
  • Chronic Illness management

What sessions look like

In a typical session we address immediate executive functioning concerns while building adaptable skills for stability in long-term habits and routines.

Go-to strengths

  • PDA support
  • Routines and consistency
  • Transitions and life changes
  • Trans-informed career navigation

Relevant experience

  • Academic planning and career materials support: University of Virginia (2 years)
  • Project manager (3 years)
  • Academic Tutoring privately and commercially, students aged 8-20 (5 years)

Education & training

B.A. English Literature and Language

Personal neurodivergent experience

My experience as a queer autistic person from the South has shaped my holistic and intersectional approaches to Executive Function repair.

Outside of coaching

Outside of coaching I spend my time DJing and producing music or at home curled up with a horror movie and a knitting project.
author: ChrisHanson
